verses.saheeh: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
verses.khattab: By those ˹winds˺ sent forth successively
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By those sent in succession (‘urfan), that is, [by] the winds that follow [one another] in succession, like the mane (‘urf) of a horse, one part [of hair] coming after the other (‘urfan is in the accusative because it is a circumstantial qualifier);

verses.saheeh: And the winds that blow violently
verses.khattab: and those blowing violently
verses.jalalayn: ﻿by the raging hurricanes, the violent winds;

verses.saheeh: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
verses.khattab: and those scattering ˹rainclouds˺ widely
verses.jalalayn: ﻿by the sweeping spreaders, [by] the winds that scatter the rains;

verses.saheeh: And those [angels] who bring criterion
verses.khattab: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿by the decisive discriminators, that is, [by] the verses of the Qur'an, which discriminate between truth and falsehood, and between what is lawful and what is unlawful;

verses.saheeh: And those [angels] who deliver a message
verses.khattab: and those delivering revelation
verses.jalalayn: ﻿by the casters of the remembrance, that is, [by] angels that descend with the revelation upon the prophets and messengers, casting the revelation onto the [various] communities [of mankind],

verses.saheeh: As justification or warning,
verses.khattab: ending excuses and giving warnings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿to excuse or to warn, that is to say, in order to excuse or to warn on behalf of God, exalted be He (a variant reading [for nudhran and ‘udhran] has nudhuran and ‘udhuran).

verses.saheeh: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
verses.khattab: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely that which you are promised, O disbelievers of Mecca, in the way of resurrection and chastisement, will befall: it will be, without any doubt.

verses.saheeh: So when the stars are obliterated
verses.khattab: So when the stars are put out
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So when the stars are obliterated, [when] their light is extinguished,

verses.saheeh: And when the heaven is opened
verses.khattab: and the sky is torn apart
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the heaven is rent asunder,

verses.saheeh: And when the mountains are blown away
verses.khattab: and the mountains are blown away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the mountains are blown away, crushed to pieces and blown in the air,

verses.saheeh: And when the messengers' time has come...
verses.khattab: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the time is set for the [testimony of the] messengers (read uqqitat or wuqqitat), that is to say, [when] they are gathered to an appointed time,

wbw.translation: are gathered to their appointed time.

verses.saheeh: For what Day was it postponed?
verses.khattab: for which Day has all this been set
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For what day — for a tremendous day — has it been appointed?, [it has been appointed] for witnessing [of the messengers] against their communities [to the effect] that they delivered [their messages from God].

verses.saheeh: For the Day of Judgement.
verses.khattab: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For the Day of Decision, for creatures (from this one may infer the response to [the clauses beginning with] idhā, ‘when’, in other words, ‘[when …], the decision will be made for [all] creatures’).

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
verses.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And how would you know what the Day of Decision is? — emphasising the enormity of its terror.

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day! — a threat of chastisement for them.

verses.saheeh: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
verses.khattab: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did We not destroy the ancients, for their denial, in other words, We certainly destroyed them,

verses.saheeh: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
verses.khattab: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then made the latter folk follow them?, [the latter folk] of those who denied, such as the disbelievers of Mecca, whom We will destroy.

verses.saheeh: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
verses.khattab: This is how We deal with the wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So, just as We dealt with those who denied, will We deal with the guilty, with every individual who will be guilty in the future, and destroy them.

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day! — [reiterated] for emphasis.

verses.saheeh: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
verses.khattab: Did We not create you from a humble fluid
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did We not create you from a base fluid, one that is delicate — and this is semen,

verses.saheeh: And We placed it in a firm lodging
verses.khattab: placing it in a secure place
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then lodged it in a secure abode, that is, the womb,

verses.saheeh: For a known extent.
verses.khattab: until an appointed time
verses.jalalayn: ﻿for a known span?, namely, the time for delivery.

verses.saheeh: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
verses.khattab: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus We were able, to do this; so [how] excellent able ones We are!

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.saheeh: Have We not made the earth a container
verses.khattab: Have We not made the earth a lodging
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have We not made the earth a receptacle (kifātan is a verbal noun, from kafata, meaning damma, ‘enclosed’), that is, an enclosure,

verses.saheeh: Of the living and the dead?
verses.khattab: for the living and the dead
verses.jalalayn: ﻿for the living, on its surface, and the dead, inside it,

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا
verses.indopak: وَّجَعَلْنَا فِيْهَا رَوَاسِىَ شٰمِخٰتٍ وَّ اَسْقَيْنٰكُمْ مَّاۤءً فُرَاتًاۗ
verses.transliteration: waja'alna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan
verses.saheeh: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
verses.khattab: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and set therein soaring mountains and give you sweet water to drink?

wbw.translation: and We gave you to drink

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنْطَلِقُوْۤا اِلٰى مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَۚ
verses.transliteration: intaliqoo ila ma kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
verses.saheeh: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
verses.khattab: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And on the Day of Resurrection it will be said to the deniers: Depart to that, chastisement, which you used to deny!

verses.uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ
verses.indopak: اِنْطَلِقُوْۤا اِلٰى ظِلٍّ ذِىْ ثَلٰثِ شُعَبٍ
verses.saheeh: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
verses.khattab: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Depart to a triple-forked shadow — this is the smoke of Hell, which, as it rises, splits into three parts because of its magnitude —

verses.uthmani: لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
verses.indopak: لَا ظَلِيْلٍ وَّلَا يُغْنِىْ مِنَ اللَّهَبِۗ
verses.saheeh: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
verses.khattab: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames
verses.jalalayn: ﻿which is neither shady, [neither] protective, [unable] to shade them from the heat of that Day, nor of any avail against, [nor] wards off from them anything of, the flame, the Fire.

verses.saheeh: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
verses.khattab: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed it, that is, the Fire, throws up sparks, namely, those [flame] that are thrown by it into the air, [huge] like palace edifices, in terms of their enormity and vertical extension,

verses.saheeh: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
verses.khattab: and ˹as dark˺ as black camels.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as if they were [dark] yellow camels (jimālātun is the plural of jimalatun, the plural of jamalun; a variant reading has jimālatun), in terms of their shape and colour. In hadīth [it is stated], ‘The sparks of humans [thrown into the air by the Fire] are black as pitch (qīr)’; the Arabs call dark camels sufr, ‘yellow’, because a touch of yellow is mixed with their blackish colour, and therefore it is said that ‘yellow’ in this verse [actually] means ‘black’, on account of what has been mentioned; but some say no [to this interpretation]; (sharar is the plural of sharāra; qīr is qār, ‘pitch’).

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.saheeh: This is a Day they will not speak,
verses.khattab: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This, namely, the Day of Resurrection, is the day in which they will not utter, anything,

verses.saheeh: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
verses.khattab: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses
verses.jalalayn: ﻿nor will they be given permission, to offer excuses, and so offer excuses (fa-ya‘tadhirūna is a supplement to yu’dhanu, ‘given permission’, but without being a direct result of it, since it belongs within the confines of the [general] denial [of permission], in other words, ‘there will be no permission, hence no excuses’).

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.saheeh: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘This is the Day of Decision. We have brought you, O deniers from this community, and the ancients together, [the ancients] from among the deniers before you, so that you will [all] be reckoned with and chastised together;

verses.saheeh: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
verses.khattab: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So if you have any stratagems, any ploy to ward off your chastisement, try your strategems against Me!’ — put them into effect!

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
verses.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly the God-fearing will be amid shades, that is, amid clusters of trees, since there is no sun therein from whose heat to seek shade, and springs, issuing forth with water,

verses.saheeh: And fruits from whatever they desire,
verses.khattab: and any fruit they desire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and fruits such as they desire: this is meant to point out that eating and drinking in Paradise is [done] according to their desires, in contrast to [the case in] this world, where it is predominantly determined by what people are able to procure. It will also be said to them:

verses.uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: كُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا هَنِيْۤئًا بِۢمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Eat and drink in [full] enjoyment (hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier, in other words, mutahanni’īna) for what you used to do’, in the way of obedience.

verses.saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.khattab: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed so, in the same way that We reward the God-fearing, do We reward the virtuous.

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.saheeh: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
verses.khattab: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Eat and enjoy — addressing the disbelievers in this world — for a little, time, at the end of which comes death — this is meant as a threat for them. Indeed you are guilty!’

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوْا لَا يَرْكَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waitha qeela lahumu irka'oo la yarka'oona
verses.saheeh: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
verses.khattab: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For when it is said to them, ‘Bow down!’, perform prayer, they do not bow down, they do not perform prayer.

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.saheeh: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
verses.khattab: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In what discourse, then, after this, namely, the Qur'an, will they believe? In other words, they cannot believe in any other of God’s Scriptures after having denied this [Qur'an], since it comprises that inimitability (i‘jāz) which none of the others do.
